download_s2ef_data: run the download_data script to download and preprocess s2ef training data for a specified split
download_is2re_data: run the download_data script to download and extract is2re train val test data
run_get_data: run get_data to download extract and organize s2ef or is2re dataset files into a target directory
verify_s2ef_count: run verify_count to check that the preprocessed s2ef data matches the expected sample count
cleanup_intermediate_files: run cleanup to remove downloaded tar files and intermediate directories after data processing
